Center: mean and median

Placeholder paragraph for the test fixture. The mean adds every value and divides by the count, so a single very large value pulls it toward the tail. The median is the middle of the ordered data and barely moves when one value changes. Quartiles split each half of the ordered data again, and the interquartile range $Q_3 - Q_1$ measures the spread of the middle half. The standard deviation measures a typical distance from the mean.
